items.title: John Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 18, 2023 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Oscar Peterson and that music... It was a specific group I think.

ctx.x: Well you know I had this conversation with Isaiah. And I was saying you know I get lucky because I manage to find piano players who want to swing, who want to play tunes, and participate in the band like that. I’ve heard — I mean I’ve been in bands where I’m the guy who’s trying to play rhythm guitar and the group is a completely different animal and the rhythm guitar is a dinosaur and you sort of just go oh, I’m fighting the wrong fight here. And so I’m amazed that I can find piano players who want to play tunes…
